content.text:
I rewrote `frontend/src/scenes/notebooks/Notebook/TableMenu.tsx`. The table BubbleMenu is gone, so it no longer sits on top of the text formatting menu. I haven't type-checked, linted or tried it in a browser: running oxlint in this session needs your approval.

**How it works now**
- **Hover:** hovering a cell in a document table shows two drag-icon handles, one to the left of its row and one above its column (the same icon turned sideways). Tables inside notebook nodes are skipped, as the existing table styles already do.
- **No flicker:** each handle sits in an invisible fixed-position wrapper that reaches 6px into the table. Moving the mouse from a cell to its handle never leaves the hover area, so the handles stay put.
- **Menus:** clicking a handle opens a `LemonMenu` popover.
  - Row: Insert row above, Insert row below, Delete row.
  - Column: Insert column left, Insert column right, Delete column.
  - Both menus also end with Delete table, which the old BubbleMenu had, so that action isn't lost.
- **State:** the hovered cell and which menu is open are local React state. The handles stay visible while a menu is open, and hide once it closes or you move away from the table.
- **Which cell the commands act on:** the handles are outside the editor, so each action first moves the selection into the hovered cell, then runs the TipTap table command.
- **Position:** handles are placed from the cell's live on-screen position and re-placed on scroll, resize and editor updates. The only inline `style` is for those computed positions, with the same `react/forbid-dom-props` disable comment used elsewhere in notebooks.

`Editor.tsx` needed no changes, since it already renders `<TableMenu />` only when the notebook is editable.

I rewrote `frontend/src/scenes/notebooks/Notebook/TableMenu.tsx`. The table BubbleMenu is gone, so it no longer sits on top of the text formatting menu. I haven't type-checked, linted or tried it in a browser: running oxlint in this session needs your approval.

**How it works now**
- **Hover:** hovering a cell in a document table shows two drag-icon handles, one to the left of its row and one above its column (the same icon turned sideways). Tables inside notebook nodes are skipped, as the existing table styles already do.
- **No flicker:** each handle sits in an invisible fixed-position wrapper that reaches 6px into the table. Moving the mouse from a cell to its handle never leaves the hover area, so the handles stay put.
- **Menus:** clicking a handle opens a `LemonMenu` popover.
  - Row: Insert row above, Insert row below, Delete row.
  - Column: Insert column left, Insert column right, Delete column.
  - Both menus also end with Delete table, which the old BubbleMenu had, so that action isn't lost.
- **State:** the hovered cell and which menu is open are local React state. The handles stay visible while a menu is open, and hide once it closes or you move away from the table.
- **Which cell the commands act on:** the handles are outside the editor, so each action first moves the selection into the hovered cell, then runs the TipTap table command.
- **Position:** handles are placed from the cell's live on-screen position and re-placed on scroll, resize and editor updates. The only inline `style` is for those computed positions, with the same `react/forbid-dom-props` disable comment used elsewhere in notebooks.

`Editor.tsx` needed no changes, since it already renders `<TableMenu />` only when the notebook is editable.

To check it, run `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend typescript:check` and oxlint on the file, then hover and click the handles in a notebook table.
